en-US.title: OFW Salary Calculator
en-US.short_description: Compute your net salary, tax & remittance as an Overseas Filipino Worker.
en-US.full_description: OFW Salary Calculator helps Overseas Filipino Workers see exactly what lands in hand after tax, SSS / PhilHealth / Pag-IBIG, and agency deductions. Estimate your net pay and how much you can remit home in seconds — simple, fast, and free.

fil.title: OFW Sahod Calculator
fil.short_description: Kalkulahin ang iyong netong sahod, buwis, at padala bilang Overseas Filipino Worker.
fil.full_description: Tinutulungan ng OFW Salary Calculator ang mga Overseas Filipino Worker na malaman kung magkano ang matitira sa sahod pagkaraan ng buwis, SSS / PhilHealth / Pag-IBIG, at agency deductions. Tantiya ang iyong netong sahod at kung magkano ang pwedeng ipadala sa bahay sa ilang segundos lang — simple, mabilis, at libre.

ar.title: حاسبة راتب العمال OFW
ar.short_description: احسب صافي راتبك والضرائب والتحويلات كعامل فلبيني في الخارج.
ar.full_description: يساعد تطبيق OFW Salary Calculator العمال الفلبينيين في الخارج على معرفة صافي راتبهم بعد الضرائب، واشتراكات SSS / PhilHealth / Pag-IBIG، وخصومات الوكالة. قدّر صافي راتبك ومبلغ التحويل إلى الوطن في ثوانٍ — بسيط وسريع ومجاني.
